description: This source file implements the TraceLogger class for logging diagnostic events within the CalculatorApp. It includes methods for logging window creation, mode changes, user interactions, exceptions, and other application-specific events, utilizing Windows Runtime and custom logging infrastructure.

classes.name: TraceLogger
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for logging various diagnostic and user interaction events within the CalculatorApp, utilizing Windows Runtime logging facilities and custom event definitions.
